changelog: - **SSO sign-in and Google Calendar connect finish on the host they started on; the rest of the e-mail links follow the recipient's tenant** (#2494, #2495 last slice). SAML: the login route sends the originating origin as `RelayState` (only when it is not `NEXTAUTH_URL`'s), and the ACS — still the one endpoint registered at the IdP — redirects to `/auth/sso/complete` or its refusal on that origin, accepted only through the new `servedOrigin()` in `src/lib/servedHosts.ts` (a bare https origin of a served host by exact match; anything else falls back, so the unsigned RelayState is no open redirect). Google: the connect route signs the origin into the OAuth `state` (5-part form; the old 4-part form still verifies), and the registered callback hands a verified state back to the same callback on that host in one hop, where the session check and token exchange run as before. E-mail (on top of #2590's per-recipient origins): the token URL builders also accept a `null` origin, and message mails (footer, reaction and mark-read links), announcement footers and meeting invites (account, instant and guest) pass the tenant's org so their links open its host; meeting, series and missing-document reminders, re-engagement, company-need alerts and the weekly analytics report hand `sendEmail()` the same org their body links came from, so one mail never spans two hosts (`optOutParts()` is the testable footer step); `orgLinkOrigin.ts` gains `appOriginForUser()` and a per-run `appOriginMemo()`. The one-click unsubscribe GET now always answers with a relative `Location`. Deliberately unchanged: the `List-Id` identifier, and the SP metadata / ACS / Google redirect URI, which are registered endpoints.

en: Signing in with your company's SSO, or connecting Google Calendar, from SaleVali now brings you back to SaleVali — and the unsubscribe and preference links in SaleVali e-mails open SaleVali too.
tr: SaleVali'den şirketinin SSO'suyla giriş yapmak ya da Google Takvim'i bağlamak artık seni yine SaleVali'ye döndürüyor; SaleVali e-postalarındaki abonelikten çıkma ve tercih bağlantıları da SaleVali'yi açıyor.
de: Die Anmeldung per Firmen-SSO und das Verbinden von Google Kalender aus SaleVali führen jetzt zurück zu SaleVali – und die Abmelde- und Einstellungslinks in SaleVali-E-Mails öffnen ebenfalls SaleVali.
